title: HabETH - Habit Tracking & Accountability
tagline: We all have tried and failed sticking to habits, with us you need to stake ETH to follow a habit & a failure leads to loss of the staked amount & it's interest to accountability partner
how_its_made: We wanted to build a mobile app using React Native, but we were NOT able to integrate Biconomy, Web3UIKit, Moralis. We kept getting issues with dependency resolution let alon getting anything working. Since we had limited time we decided to move to building a web app. Then we found out that react-moralis only works with moralis-v1, but moralis-v1 is now deprecated. Till saturday evening we basically just got an intro to different tools we could use & finally ended up using ethers.js
